evidence.testName: every OK and STALE cell shows its vendor and its source timestamp with no interaction

results.note: Vendor (OKX) and source timestamp are asserted visible before any fireEvent, and the <details> is asserted not open. In CellFace.tsx the vendor/timestamp spans are children of <summary> (via CellDetail), so jest-dom's toBeVisible() (which special-cases closed <details>) can only pass if they render outside the collapsed region — confirming they are on the initial render.

evidence.testName: a STALE cell shows its age in the same glance as its value

results.note: Asserts the summary text "11,111.1 · 1 day old" is visible, sourced from CellFace.tsx's STALE branch (`formatAge(state.publishedAt ?? state.sourceTimestamp, now)`), which sits in the always-visible primary detail span, not behind the disclosure.

evidence.testName: the timestamp shown is source_timestamp and not fetched_at

results.note: Fixture has fetchedAt=2026-09-14T00:01:00Z and sourceTimestamp=2026-09-13T00:00:00Z (a day apart); the test asserts the source_timestamp string is visible in the summary and explicitly queries that the fetched_at-formatted string is NOT present. CellFace.tsx only renders `cell.state.sourceTimestamp` in the always-visible cell-provenance span.

evidence.testName: an ERROR cell shows its reason and shows no number at all

results.note: Asserts the reason label ("Fetch failed") and detail text render, and that no element with data-testid="cell-value" exists. CellFace.tsx only sets that testid for OK/STALE states, so an ERROR cell cannot expose a numeric value.

evidence.testName: a cell with a reference period distinct from its publication date shows both

results.note: Simulates a lagged macro series (usd_m2) with referencePeriod=2026-07-01 and publishedAt=2026-09-08 and asserts both distinct dates and their "Reference period"/"Published" labels render — the field pair CellFace.tsx exposes via cell.state.referencePeriod / cell.state.publishedAt, present ahead of any macro-panel story.

evidence.testName: opening a cell reveals endpoint source field and fetch time

results.note: Asserts endpoint, source field and formatted fetch time are absent until the summary is clicked, then present after — matching CellDetail.tsx's <dl> (Endpoint/Source field/Fetch time) rendered outside <summary>, i.e. one interaction deeper, never the first thing shown.

evidence.testName: the detail view can be opened and closed by keyboard alone

results.note: Focuses the summary and toggles the <details> open/closed purely via Enter and Space keydown events (CellDetail.tsx's toggleWithKeyboard), proving the disclosure is operable without a mouse and is a normal part of page markup (native <details>/<summary>), not a hover-only feature. CellFace is wired into BoardMatrix.tsx:33, so it is part of the assembled page, not an isolated component.
